comment: Baseline of known TCP-port collisions between tests/integration/test_*.py files, generated by scripts/ci/check_port_collisions.py --update. A collision here means two or more test files both reference the same 6000-6999 port literal, almost always because each starts its own peadb-server on that port. This is tolerated only because run_integration_tests.sh runs files strictly sequentially and each test tears down its own server before the next one starts (see that script's straggler-reaping comment for the one place that assumption can briefly break). Entries here are grandfathered and do not fail CI; check_port_collisions.py fails only when a *new* collision -- a port not listed here at all, or a new file joining an already-listed port's set -- shows up, so a developer adding a colliding port to a new test finds out from CI without a hundred existing files needing to be renumbered.
